svg.title: Tracking Monkey Typing: commits, lines, and tokens
svg.desc: Tracking Monkey Typing shows lifetime aggregate weekly commits and authored line movement, followed by anonymous Codex and Claude family token history in a separately dated inset when history is available. Code movement across the whole record at weekly grain. Totals: 8,057 GitHub-credited commits and 7,133 authored commits. The 924-commit gap contains merges and deploys and is drawn as the band between the total boundary and authored line. Authored commits carry 49,671,696 additions and 40,547,701 deletions across 201 active weeks. The lifetime context uses a COMMITS / WEEK · LOG1P axis; the AUTHORED LINES / WEEK · SYMLOG axis shows additions and deletions. The whole record is shown once, at full width, as one restrained lifetime trace for each measure, covering 470 weekly buckets through the last completed day. Rounded combined agent lifetime: 141.8B tokens, observed Aug 28, 2026. 120 completed-day family observations from Apr 30, 2026 through Aug 27, 2026. Dates before tracking began are unobserved, not zero. The token inset uses its own labeled observed-date window and a linear axis from zero. Multi-day observation gaps are dashed. Protected Codex account readings are aggregated before publication; Claude covers retained local usage; per-account readings and identities are not published. Provenance: automatic refresh. Exact family totals: Codex 124,703,591,860 tokens and Claude 17,109,243,873 tokens. Displayed shares are Codex 87.94% and Claude 12.06%. The neutral boundary traces their combined total. The approximate conversion is ~$108.8K using this site's current blended public API replay rate of 0.767464 dollars per million tokens as of 2026-07-12; it is not an actual bill.
svg.text: Lifetime code movement and recent Codex + Claude token history

Authored line movement encodings: solid means additions and dashed means removals
